steps.title: From a schema to an authoring form
items: 1 · Define the content in the Schema Editor
2 · Authors get a form built from it
3 · No block or code changes needed

steps.caption: In the **Schema Editor**, pick the **Frescopa app** schema
It lists every field: types, required fields and allowed values
Documents in **/en/app** open in the form editor
The form is built from the schema: labels, help text and dropdowns
Authors fill in fields, so they can't break the app's structure
The **Outline** jumps between parts of the document

steps.title: One schema, one form, valid content
items: Schemas live in the Schema Editor (Apps)
editor.path in the config picks which folders use the form
Published documents are served as JSON
